context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 31 validated the new cart persistence feature. All cart API endpoints (GET/PUT/DELETE /api/cart) are working correctly with httpOnly cookie authentication. Cart is user-scoped and stored in MongoDB 'carts' collection. Frontend uses dual-write pattern: localStorage for instant access + backend for cross-session persistence. The app requires authentication for user pages - unauthenticated users are redirected to onboarding/login flow. Admin panel accessible via /admin-login with email/password.
